Spice (melange): Prescience-inducing substance produced by sandworms, dependent on desert conditions
Sandworm: Shai-Hulud — the apex ecological entity of Arrakis; spice-producer
Bene Gesserit: Matrilineal religious-political order running a millennia-long breeding program
Kwisatz Haderach: Bene Gesserit name for a male who can access the Other Memory; prescient superman
Fremen: Desert-adapted inhabitants of Arrakis; engineered messiah culture
Mentat: Human computer — trained reasoning, post-Butlerian-Jihad substitute for AI
Butlerian Jihad: The war against thinking machines that shaped the Imperium's technology
Shai-Hulud: Fremen name for the sandworm; god-figure and ecological engine
Irulan epigraphs: In-world chapter openings by Princess Irulan; meta-commentary device
Prescience: Seeing possible futures; Herbert's central metaphor for leadership trap
Kwisatz Haderach trap: The prescient one is captive to the futures they see
Water discipline: Fremen practice of conserving body water; encodes entire cultural ethics
CHOAM: The Imperial trading company; economic substrate of the Imperium
Other Memory: Genetic memory accessed by Bene Gesserit Reverend Mothers
Gom jabbar: The test of humanity — ritual knife with fatal poison
Scattering: The post-God-Emperor dispersal of humanity across the galaxy
